items.title: Ray Lopez Interview, 1958-08-30
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...George Cayley. Pierce. Pierce, Charlie, is it? Charlie Pierce. Was that a Charlie Pierce from Chicago, I wonder? [INTERVIEWEE] No, no, no.

ctx.x: Love is Just a Flower, Before You Go I'll Cry For You, Peggy Deer, I Don't Know What You Want to Cry For Me, Havana, Weary Weasel, Applesauce, Mandalay. Yeah.

Oh, yeah, that's the river, there's the program of the Coconut Grove. Yeah. Gorham's Follies, here's the guy who sent us up. Well, Gorham's Follies, yeah. John Gorham. Mm-hmm. Yeah. And they list all the personnel here. Yeah. Gus Arnheim, John Thunberger, George Cayley. Pierce. Pierce, Charlie, is it? Charlie Pierce. Was that a Charlie Pierce from Chicago, I wonder?
